| description = The ones in Iceclad are as much as 10 levels lower than the ones in Great Divide, which can be blue to a level 60. Some of the ones in Great Divide actually appear to have more like 9500 health: Necro's Cascading Darkness + Splurt + Envenomed Bolt (1152 + 1819 + 1278 = 4249 total damage) brought down an elite to 55% health. Update 1/8/23: Wizard quad with Pillar of Flame at 947 dmg per takes 7 casts, so their health is closer to 6500. Immune to [[Spirit Strike]] procs from [[Bow of the Huntsman]], so possibly immune to Cold spells.

In regards to the necro's testing above, dots on moving (non-feared) targets do 2/3 damage I believe.

Anecdote: 4/22/2026 - Spent some time leveling a selfound character on the ones in Iceclad. Hope was to obtain one of the three rare weapons from the loot table. Good exp, good camp, however after around 800 kills all that dropped were the other rare items on the loot table but none of the three rare weapons or the woven beard. So either the weapons were removed from these, being of lower level in Iceclad, or the drop rates here are practically non existent. It does seem strange that only the weapons and the woven beard would be removed but none of the other rare items, if that is case.
